Source organisation: OpenCity.in aggregating http://opendata.punecorporation.org; author listed: Vaidyanathan R. Landing page: https://data.opencity.in/dataset/pune-census-2011-data ; resource page: https://data.opencity.in/dataset/pune-census-2011-data/resource/49f1fca6-6904-48de-ad4c-199108048658 . NOT analysis-ready. Before any join or choropleth: keep rows whose Census Ward Number is an integer AND drop every row whose Ward Name is Yewalewadi, plus all 'Total' rows. The Yewalewadi row carries integer ward number 1 but is not a PMC ward, so an integer-ward filter alone keeps it and double-counts ward 1 (the CSV has 160 rows: 144 wards + 15 subtotal/total rows + 1 Yewalewadi row). After that filter: 144 rows, wards 1-144 with no duplicates, and the sums reproduce the official historical PMC control totals exactly (population 3124458; SC 419396; ST 34025; households 742602). Intended join: integer ward number to wardnum in data/raw/pune-pre-2012-144-ward-boundaries_nikhilvj.geojson (community-published, see its own entry in this file; the two wardnum sets match 1:1, 144 of 144, verified 2026-10-26). Treat that boundary's correspondence to Census geography as the author's statement, not an official certification. File is UTF-8 WITH BOM: read as encoding='utf-8-sig' or the first column name will carry a BOM. SHA-256 verified locally on 2026-10-26 against the copy filed in data/raw/ (byte-identical to the download).
